text:
So arduously the sea,
so arduously,
the slow, immense sea,
so long within itself, so tired,
the deep, eternal sea.

Slow sea, deep sea,
immense, profound sea…

So slowly, deeply, so long, so much,
insistent and tired being falling
like an endless weeping,
heavily,
tenaciously dying…

It grows calm from the depths,
grows wisely,
slowly, deeply, at length,
with measured pace,
sea,
arduous, weary sea,
Father of my silence.

translation.title: El mar
